title: XDAO - Open App
meta_description: xdao routes you to the official app for DAO creation, treasury governance, multisig workflows, and multi-chain asset management.
hero_h2: Create a DAO, govern treasury, and coordinate members
hero_lead: xdao opens the official DAO builder for launching organizations, coordinating members, managing treasuries, and routing proposals across supported Web3 networks.
what_is: XDAO is a multi-chain DAO framework for creating blockchain organizations, managing shared crypto assets, and approving treasury actions through voting. Its official documentation covers setup, governance tokens, supported blockchains, and security resources.

how.d: Use the verified app domain, choose the desktop EVM route or Telegram route, and connect the wallet you intend to use.
Start a new organization or open an existing workspace before setting treasury and member controls.
Configure members, voting power, quorum, and proposal rules so treasury actions require approval.
Check the network, wallet prompt, and transaction details before deploying or approving any on-chain action.

points.p: The action route is app.xdao.app; verify the domain before connecting a wallet or signing transactions.
Teams can coordinate member roles, voting thresholds, proposals, and treasury actions through a shared organization wallet.
The official site positions the product for EVM-compatible networks and TON, with desktop, mobile web, and Telegram Mini App access.

faq.a: xdao is a Web3 tool for creating and managing DAOs, including treasury workflows, member coordination, governance voting, and shared asset management.
This page is a gateway, not the product itself; the official action URL is app.xdao.app/1.

faq.q: What can I do with xdao?
faq.a: You can create a DAO, configure governance settings, manage a treasury, coordinate members, and use supported modules such as crowdfunding or DeFi interactions where available.
The official site lists broad EVM-compatible network support plus TON access for Telegram workflows; check the app and docs for the current live network list.

faq.q: What does xdao mean by DAO governance?
faq.a: DAO governance means shared rules for proposals, voting, and execution; Ethereum.org provides a neutral DAO overview for the broader concept.

footer_note: This page is not the official app; verify app.xdao.app before connecting a wallet. Educational only, not financial advice.
